izzyondroid:org.meowcat.edxposed.manager.name: EdXposed Manager
izzyondroid:org.meowcat.edxposed.manager.description:
EdXposed is a framework for modules that can change the behavior of the system and apps without touching any APKs, and supports Android 8 to 11. That’s great because it means that modules can work for different versions and even ROMs without any changes (as long as the original code was not changed too much). It’s also easy to undo. As all changes are done in the memory, you just need to deactivate the module and reboot to get your original system back.
 There are many other advantages, but here is just one more: Multiple modules can do changes to the same part of the system or app. With modified APKs, you to decide for one. No way to combine them, unless the author builds multiple APKs with different combinations.
 EdXposed Manager is the GUI allowing you to manage your EdXposed settings, modules, etc.
 Note: the app's repo is no longer maintained, so there won't be further updates here.

fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.name: Poleidoscope
fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.summary: A kaleidoscope based on complex polynomials. Trippy.
fdroid:com.example.poleidoscope.description:
Did you ever wonder what the world looks like through a 
holomorphic function? 
No? Wondering what a 'holomorphic function' is in the first place? 
Don't worry! You don't need to know any of this to use the app. 
Just touch the screen and see the math at work! 
The Poleidoscope shows a rectangular domain of the plane of complex numbers. 
The user sets up roots and poles of a rational function on the screen 
and this function is then used to deflect the live camera picture. 
Holomorphic functions are examples of so-called 'conformal mappings' which 
are prominently featured in the works of contemporary artists such 
as M.C. Escher. The Poleidoscope provides a live experience of similar 
pictures. 
For those more involved in mathematics the app is a way to visualize 
complex polynomials and rational functions and give a feeling for 
several topics in complex analysis such as differentials of holomorphic 
functions, Rouche's theorem, ramifications, local normal forms, etc.

Todosian reads and writes your existing .md files directly. There is no database import, no account, and no built-in sync.

- Connect a folder using Android's Storage Access Framework (SAF)
- Each Markdown file becomes a category
- Todos use standard Markdown checkboxes: - [ ] and - [x]

- Add / edit / toggle / delete todos
- Create / rename / delete categories (files)

- Offline-first and privacy-focused (no analytics)
 Notes 
- Todosian modifies your Markdown files directly. Keep a reliable backup of your vault/folder.
- Todosian is independent and not affiliated with Obsidian or the Obsidian Tasks plugin.

fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.name: Bouncy
fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.summary: A tiny bouncing ball that plays musical notes when it hits the walls.
fdroid:io.github.ebraminio.bouncy.description:
Bouncy is a simple, joyful little app: fling a ball across your screen, and
watch it bounce off the walls — playing a cheerful musical note each time it
hits.
Every bounce produces a tone from the diatonic scale, so the ball essentially
plays a little tune as it moves around. A visual effect (powered by Android's
AGSL shader language) that changes by each wall hit.
That's the whole app. No levels, no score, no accounts — just a ball, some
physics, and a bit of music.
Features:
* Fling the ball with a swipe and watch it go
* Each wall bounce plays a note from the diatonic musical scale
* Smooth, realistic physics using Android's FlingAnimation
* Visual glow effect rendered with AGSL distance field shaders
* Extremely lightweight: the entire app is under 18 KB
* No internet connection, no ads, no tracking, no permissions

Tap letters on the keyboard to enter a guess. Use the Back key to backspace. When you have finished a guess, tap the Enter key.
Letters which are in the word but in the wrong place will turn yellow. If they are in the right place they will turn green. If they are not in the word they will turn grey. Keep trying until you have guessed the word. The display will scroll up if you run out of guesses.

flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.name: Chromium B.S.U.
flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.summary: Fast paced, arcade-style, top-scrolling space shooter
flathub:net.sourceforge.chromium-bsu.description:
You are captain of the cargo ship Chromium B.S.U., responsible for delivering supplies to our
 troops on the front line. Your ship has a small fleet of robotic fighters which you control from
 the relative safety of the Chromium vessel. This is an OpenGL-based shoot 'em up game with fine
 graphics.
 Your mission:
 Do not let ANY enemy ships get past your fighters! Each enemy ship that makes it past the
 bottom of the screen will attack the Chromium, and you lose a fighter.
 Use your fighters as weapons! Crash into enemies to destroy them before they can get past
 you.
 Strategic suicide is a powerful tactic! When the Chromium launches a new fighter, it releases
 a high energy burst which destroys all enemies in range.
 Self-destruct to preserve your ammunition! A double-right-click will cause your current fighter
 to self-destruct. Before the ship blows up, it ejects its ammunition so that the next fighter
 can pick it up.

firefox-addons:2647934.name: Private Notes
firefox-addons:2647934.summary:
Private Notes gives you safe, fully encrypted place for your Top Secret notes! 
Ideal for storing recovery codes, WiFi passwords, access tokens, server configs...
firefox-addons:2647934.description:
Private Notes allows you to write password-protected, fully encrypted notes.
Your notes can be synchronized with encrypted (again!) Firefox Sync. engine with other devices.
 Ideal for storing the most sensitive information, like Recovery codes, Wi-Fi passwords, server configs, etc... 
 Privacy and permissions: 
 There are no permissions - this addon can't make any remote requests or submit any data!
 All data are always encrypted and then synchronized by Firefox build-in End-to-End encrypted "Firefox Sync" engine (yes, data are double encrypted!).
 Your password is NOT stored at all. It's hashed using advanced PBKDF2 function with 100k iterations and strong salt.
 Unlocked notes and decryption keys are never stored on drive - they stay in the system RAM memory (not accessible by any other app and cleared when browser is closed).
 Even if someone gains physical access to your PC, he won't be able to access your notes nor password. This is one of the safest place ever created! 
 Top features: 
 Encrypted notes - all your notes are always stored encrypted!
 Auto-lock - will help you keep your notes locked when you leave your PC
 Automatic backups - each device creates encrypted local backups of your notes. Plus Firefox Sync engine keeps encrypted backup in Firefox cloud.
 End to End encryption - all transferred data are again encrypted thanks to Firefox Sync between your Firefox browsers.
 No need to create additional account - Firefox Sync will handle everything
 Advanced Text Editor - supports many advanced text features
 Code highlight for many popular languages and configs
 Compression - all notes are compressed to save space
 To synchronize your encrypted notes between devices: 
 enable Firefox Sync feature - just login to your Firefox account using toolbar icon
 enable "Add-ons" synchronization - in the Firefox Options page ("about:preferences#sync") on the "Sync" tab check "Add-ons" checkbox
 Limitations of Firefox Sync engine: 
 No Android! Firefox Sync cannot synchronize addons data on Android :(
 Firefox Sync can handle only 100KB of data - so you can't store huge notes. However thanks to build in compression, you should be able to store more than 100,000 characters of text.
 Single note only 8KB size limit - each note can have only up to 8,000 characters - again thanks to compression this should be more.
 Slow synchronization - sometimes it takes several minutes to synchronize your new notes to / from the cloud. You can trigger sync. manually from your account toolbar menu.
 Support independent developer: 
 I'm full-time add-on developer and your donations is my only income. There are no ads in my add-ons!
 Please support my work by:
 Buy me a coffee 
 PayPal donation 
 Be my Patron 
 Thank you! :) 
 Your donation will help me keep this add-on working in future versions of Firefox!
 Recently added features: 
 The list of changes in last versions is available here

bluejetty:00021266:ios.summary: The Equestrian App manages day-to-day horse activities like stall management, boarding, leasing rules, training plans, veterinarian exams, farrier visits, invoicing, ride tracking, a marketplace, and so much more. We all want the best for
bluejetty:00021266:ios.description:
The Equestrian App manages day-to-day horse activities like stall management, boarding, leasing rules, training plans, veterinarian exams, farrier visits, invoicing, ride tracking, a marketplace, and so much more. We all want the best for our horses, so we built The Equestrian App to be that exclusive, one-of-a-kind tool you can rely upon everyday for your horses healthcare and well-being. Just think of it as Microsoft Office, but for your Horses.
It's about connecting people, horses and the community that cares for them.
People • Our goal is to connect everyone in the care and enjoyment of your horse within one easy to use app
Horses • The app logs your horse's activities and care, all while connecting them to your equine service providers
Community • The app connects the entire equine industry and lifestyle in one place
Features:
- Journals: A news feed of your horse's activities and health; connected to others that help in their care.
- My Horses: Manage everything about your horse's health, activities, and records. Think of this as your electronic, on-demand file cabinet that you wish you had with you at all times.
- Contacts: From riders and farriers, to vets and more, your horse can stay connected with them all.
- Get Connected: Follow friends or become an equine influencer. Ten's of thousands of equestrians around the world will help you get noticed.
- Expenses: Track all your expenses! Basically anything that you do for the horse and barn you can now track it.
- Photos: Capture and share important moments with your horse. It could be a great trail ride you discovered early that morning.
- Activities: Journal a list of activities for you and your horse. We have an extensive list of horse care topics that can be journaled.
- Ride Tracker: Track all your rides and capture the where you rode, the distance, time and speed for each horse.
- File Upload: Want to upload a health certificate or an important documents for your horse. Now you can scan and upload those important documents to each horse.
- Discounts: We have partnered with many Premium Equine Brands in providing unique discounts for Equestrian App members.
- Printing: You bet, now we have some great reports that you can print out of the system.
- Barn Chat: Message your equestrian friends important information right within the app.
- Equine Businesses: We now support many features to run your equine business and connect to your customers in-app for free (Trainers, Lessons, Farriers, Bodywork and Boarding).
- Horse Shows and Awards: Track your progress and results at all your horse shows. Now that wall or drawer of ribbons is easily searchable and available within the app.
- Business Profiles: Are you an equine business? You can build out your business profile and promote it in our search. It's a great way to get new business and be in front of the largest community of equestrians in the world.
- Weight Tracking: Simply capture and view a horses weight over time
- HorseTag: Use your phone to scan and quickly lookup horse information
- Vaccinations: One screen to enter and track your horses vaccinations
- TODOs: Track tasks and assign them to others in the barn.
- Horse Transfer: If you're selling or transferring a horse, you can do that in one tap to another member of the app.
- 4-H Horse Program: If you're in 4-H, we have your record books and horse certificates in the app.
Not an Equestrian App member yet? Registering is free and easy! Join the tens of thousands of members already enjoying The Equestrian App every day for the management and enjoyment of their equestrian lifestyle!
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy terms: https://equestrianapp.com/privacy.html

A Rodobens, especialista em projetos de vida, possui um ecossistema único de distribuição, com amplo portfólio de serviços financeiros: Consórcio, Seguros, Crédito, Leasing e Locação.

A Rodobens tem sede em São José do Rio Preto, SP, presença em todo o território nacional e mais de 75 anos de atuação.

bluejetty:00022064:ios.name: Network Radar
bluejetty:00022064:ios.summary: Whether for troubleshooting, security, or simple curiosity, it’s always helpful to know which devices are connected to your network. Network Radar is a powerful yet easy-to-use network scanning and management tool for iPhone and iPad that g
bluejetty:00022064:ios.description:
Whether for troubleshooting, security, or simple curiosity, it’s always helpful to know which devices are connected to your network. Network Radar is a powerful yet easy-to-use network scanning and management tool for iPhone and iPad that gives you detailed insights into all devices on your network.
As Network Radar scans, it instantly displays newly discovered devices. For each device, you can view comprehensive information such as IP address, DNS names, mDNS name, open ports, response time, and more. You can also create scans with custom IP ranges. All scans are saved and can be revisited later — even when your device is no longer connected to that network.
Take advantage of the built-in network utilities, including Ping, Port Scan, Whois, and DNS lookups (forward and reverse). These tools work not only within your local network but also with external IP addresses and domains.
Network Radar is not limited to your local network. Specify custom start and end addresses to scan any reachable segment of any network from your device.
With its intuitive user interface, Network Radar is simple to use across all your iOS devices. It’s a modern, efficient app designed for iOS with minimal impact on your network.
By the way, Network Radar is also available for macOS — check it out!

bluejetty:00041855:ios.name: Smart Printer: Imprimante aрр
bluejetty:00041855:ios.summary:
Print from your iPhone to an AirPrint printer on your Wi-Fi network. Documents, photos, PDFs, emails, web pages and scans go to paper in a few taps, with no drivers and no cables.
Works with AirPrint-compatible printers. At first launch, p
bluejetty:00041855:ios.description:
Print from your iPhone to an AirPrint printer on your Wi-Fi network. Documents, photos, PDFs, emails, web pages and scans go to paper in a few taps, with no drivers and no cables.
Works with AirPrint-compatible printers. At first launch, pick your printer model and allow local network access, so the app can find printers near you.
WHAT YOU CAN PRINT
• Documents: PDFs and other files from the Files app
• Photos from your library
• Emails and attachments: share them from Mail and print
• Web pages: open any site in the built-in browser and print it
• Files from Google Drive and Dropbox
• Contacts
• Text you copied to the clipboard
• Camera shots: take a photo and print it right away
SCAN DOCUMENTS
• Scan paper documents with your iPhone camera, with flash and filters
• Scanned documents are kept in My Files, sorted by date
• Print a scan or share it
EDIT BEFORE YOU PRINT
• Edit photos and documents right in the app, then send them to the printer
READY-TO-PRINT TEMPLATES
• 91 templates to print at home: 30 coloring pages for kids, 10 coloring pages for adults, 20 mandalas and 31 planners
PRINT SETTINGS
• Paper size: A3, A4, B5 and more
• Orientation, page range and number of copies
• Double-sided printing, if your printer supports it
• Scale, margins, mirror printing and black and white
HOW TO START
1. Connect your iPhone and your printer to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Open the app and allow access to devices on your local network.
3. Choose what to print, set the options and print.
Not sure your printer supports AirPrint? See Apple's AirPrint page: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102895
PRO ACCESS
Printing from cloud storage, the document scanner and the photo and document editor are part of PRO. Start with a 3-day free trial.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time.
SUPPORT
Questions or a printer that won't connect? Open Settings in the app for answers to common questions, or write to us at support@yardex.co.
Privacy Policy: https://yardex.co/smart-printer/privacy
Terms of Use: https://yardex.co/smart-printer/eula

bluejetty:00041992:ios.description:
Start your own record label. Discover rising stars. Rewrite your legacy in the music industry.
In Music Empire: Rise to Fame, you play as the rebellious heir of a music giant who walks away from the family empire to build something of your own. Every choice you make shapes your future — from signing talent and managing scandals to navigating intense rivalries and complex relationships.
An interactive story with hundreds of decisions
With over 500 choice points, no two paths are the same. Decide who to trust, who to challenge, and how far you’ll go to protect your name.
Chase stardom or stay true to your values
Will you do whatever it takes to rise to the top, or lead your label with integrity? Your choices define your ending — and your legacy.
Business simulation meets music industry drama
Plan tours, close deals with sponsors, manage finances and turn unsigned artists into global superstars. Play smart — or take bold risks that could shake your empire.
Romance, betrayal and power plays
Unexpected encounters — like with Lola, a wealthy socialite with hidden motives — push you into high-stakes personal decisions. Will you follow your heart or focus on your mission?
A cast of unforgettable characters

bluejetty:00034921:ios.description:
The most intuitive and enjoyable way to control your Linn music system; whether you have one or more streamers at your home.
ARTIST VIEW
Searching by artist yields comprehensive results; with artist bios, top tracks, albums, ‘appears on...’, and related artists all contained in a neat, scroll-down list.
STREAM AWAY
All of your favourite high-resolution streaming services – TIDAL, Qobuz, and Deezer – and internet radio services airable, CalmRadio, and TuneIn are fully integrated inside the app. All Linn streamers are also compatible with Spotify Connect. TIDAL Radio and personalised ‘My Mixes’ pull through to Linn app too .
GLOBAL SEARCH
Quickly find what you’re looking for across all your streaming services and stored music content, all from one place.
The revamped global search function allows browsing by artist, album, genre station, or track; and pulls through gorgeous artwork and artist photography in a much-improved and better integrated experience.
DARK MODE
For a more cosy experience, when the lights are down low, dark mode is available via app settings.
NOW PLAYING
An enhanced Now Playing view displays beautiful, large-format album artwork, and includes all transport and volume controls on a single, uncluttered screen.
YOUR PLAYLISTS – ANYWHERE
Your playlists are stored in the Cloud, linked to your Linn account, meaning you always have access to your favourites – from anywhere and at any time – and can cue them up on any Linn streamer on your local network.
UPDATE AND CONFIGURE
Regular, free, over-the-air software upgrades bring performance and feature enhancements to your Linn streamer. It’s easy to ensure your system is always up-to-date with the latest version directly within the app. The ability to manage and rename sources and rooms is embedded in the app settings screens too.
THROW LEGENDARY PARTIES
Own multiple Linn streamers? Take control of every room, all from the same app, on the same iOS device. Link rooms together and enjoy the same music, perfectly synchronised throughout your home.
Linn App is compatible with all Linn Music Systems running Davaar firmware.

bluejetty:00017339:ios.summary: Put your gloves on and step inside the arena because it’s time for the big fight of the night! The Ultra Fighting Bros are ready for a big fighting show! Choose to play the single or multiplayer mode and get ready for some hard-to-beat fun
bluejetty:00017339:ios.description:
Put your gloves on and step inside the arena because it’s time for the big fight of the night! The Ultra Fighting Bros are ready for a big fighting show! Choose to play the single or multiplayer mode and get ready for some hard-to-beat fun time. Can you win this epic combat? Find out now!
HOW TO PLAY
Each fight is a best-of-three playoff and fighters have 3 lives during each round. Climb the walls of the arena and use strategy to grab your opponent from above and tackle him down, taking a life. A round ends when one of the fighters runs out of lives.
POWER MATCHES
Unlock the Power Version to gain access to the unbeatable Power Matches of the Ultra Fighting Bros. During Power Matches, several items might show up during the fights, making them much more exciting and unpredictable.
Some of the Power Matches items:
• Health - Pick to recover lives
• Freeze - Makes the walls slippery
• Electrify - Electrifies the floor and fighters lose a life on contact
• Blackout - Turns the lights off until the next hit
HIGHLIGHTS
• Fun game inspired by Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
• Single and multiplayer mode: play against the device or against a friend
• Easy but challenging gameplay
• Power Version with awesome special items and powers
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00022034:ios.description:
For every moment you need translation — travel, business trips, language learning —
bring along Papago, the smart parrot that speaks many languages.
▶ The Meaning of 'Papago'
"Papago" comes from Esperanto and means "parrot," an animal known for its exceptional language abilities.
Papago currently supports translation across 14 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Spanish, French, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Russian, German, Italian, and Arabic.
▶ Key Features
1) Text Translation
Type the text you want to translate and get real-time results.
2) Image Translation
Just snap a photo and tap the button — Papago automatically recognizes and translates text within the image.
3) Voice Translation
Speak the phrase you need translated and get real-time results.
4) Offline Translation
Use text translation even without an internet connection.
5) Conversation Translation
Have a 1:1 conversation with a foreign speaker — both parties can speak in their own language simultaneously.
6) Handwriting Translation
Just write characters with your finger, and Papago will tell you what they mean.
7) Website Translation
Enter the URL of any foreign website to translate the entire page automatically.
8) Document Translation
Upload a document and get a translation that preserves the original formatting.
9) Edu
Take a photo of study material to create your own notes with text and vocabulary learning features.
10) Dictionary
View additional meanings of words alongside translation results through dictionary information.
Travel with confidence, anytime, anywhere — with your translation partner, Papago!
▶ Required Permissions
· Microphone: Required for voice and conversation translation features.
· Speech Recognition: Required for voice translation features.
· Camera: Required to take photos for image translation.
· Photos: Required to save translated image files to your device.
· Location: Required to view nearby place information from photos captured for image translation.
* To provide voice and conversation translation in Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Russian, and Italian, we use the 'Speech Recognition' permission provided by the mobile OS. When you use voice or conversation translation in these languages with 'Speech Recognition' permission granted, voice data is transmitted to Apple in accordance with Apple's policy. No other information is transmitted.
Like Papago on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NaverPapago
Follow Papago on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/papago_naver/
※ Requires iOS 17.0 or later
※ Also available on PC/mobile web: https://papago.naver.com
※ Dark mode is supported for comfortable use in low light.
※ Report issues or errors: https://goo.gl/YqHMTi
※ Developer email: naver_market@naver.com
※ Developer phone: 1588-3820

bluejetty:00014133:ios.description:
Listen to your favorite DRM-free audiobooks with Bound.
Bound allows you to import audio files from various cloud services and play them back in a beautiful modern interface. Bound will automatically save your listening position so that you never lose your place.
Supported Audio File Types (DRM-free only): .mp3, .m4a, .m4b, .aac
Download
- Dropbox and Microsoft OneDrive.
- Apple Files.
- Web Uploader for importing from your computer via WiFi.
Manage
- Move audio files between books.
- Change cover art.
- Sort based on author, title, recently added, and recently played.
- Rename title and author.
- Choose between a number of fun themes.
- Dark mode support.
Play
- Automatically saves playback location as you progress through the book.
- Independently configure seek forward and seek backward times.
- Chapter support for audio files with embedded chapters (.m4a / .m4b / OverDrive .mp3).
- Change playback speed from 0.5X to 3.0X.
- Smart Rewind when returning to your book after a while.
- Sleep Timer with configurable time or at the end of a chapter.
- Manually bookmark locations that you want to return to.
- CarPlay support.
If you enjoy using Bound, please consider writing a review.

To Read is a simple and lightweight app designed to help you track the books you want to read and the ones you’ve already finished.

• Keep notes on every book

• iCloud sync keeps your library on all your devices

- 15 Day Hourly Forecast

- Report Weather feature
- Ads

- *No ads

- Accurate Current Conditions

- 50 frames of animation

- IW StormRisk Beta (Severe percentages on storms)

bluejetty:00029748:ios.name: WHOOP
bluejetty:00029748:ios.summary: WHOOP is the leading wearable that turns comprehensive health insights into daily action. By capturing dozens of data points every second, WHOOP delivers personalized Sleep, Strain, Recovery, Stress, and health insights—24/7. WHOOP uses tho
bluejetty:00029748:ios.description:
WHOOP is the leading wearable that turns comprehensive health insights into daily action. By capturing dozens of data points every second, WHOOP delivers personalized Sleep, Strain, Recovery, Stress, and health insights—24/7. WHOOP uses those insights to provide coaching based on your body’s unique physiology and recommends everything from when to go to bed to new daily behaviors that will help you reach your goals.
If you’re new to WHOOP, you can try both the wearable and app free for 1 month. Terms and conditions apply.
WHOOP is screenless, so all your data lives in the WHOOP app—for a distraction-free focus on your health. The WHOOP app requires a WHOOP wearable.
How it works:
Healthspan*: A powerful way to quantify your age and slow your Pace of Aging. Backed by leading longevity research, it pinpoints the daily habits that impact your long-term health.
Sleep: WHOOP helps you understand how well you sleep each night by measuring your Sleep Performance. Every morning, WHOOP provides a Sleep score from 0 to 100%. Sleep Planner calculates how much sleep you need to recover, tailored to your habits, schedule, and goals. You can even set a Haptic Alarm that wakes when you're fully rested, or at a specific time, with gentle vibration. Quality sleep is essential for improving your healthspan, metabolic mental resilience, recovery, and performance.
Recovery: WHOOP lets you know how ready you are to perform by measuring your heart rate variability, resting heart rate, sleep, and respiratory rate. You'll get a daily Recovery score on a scale of 1 to 99%. When you're in the green, you're ready for strain, when you're in the yellow or red, you may want to evaluate your training program.
Strain: WHOOP does more than just track your activity–it measures cardiovascular and muscular exertion to give you the most comprehensive view of the demands you put on your body. Each day, Strain Target will provide a Strain score from 0 to 21 and recommend your optimal target exertion range based on your Recovery score.
Stress: WHOOP gives you daily insights to pinpoint your stressors, understand your physiological response, and discover techniques to help manage. Get a real-time stress score from 0-3 and, based on your score, choose a breathwork session to enhance your alertness or increase relaxation.
Behaviors: WHOOP tracks over 160+ daily habits and behaviors—like alcohol intake, medication, and more—to better understand how these behaviors impact your body. WHOOP provides weekly guidance for behavior change and helps set accountability goals with the Journal and Weekly Plan features.
WHOOP Coach: Ask questions about your health & fitness and get highly personalized, on-demand answers. Using your unique biometric data, the latest performance science, and generative AI, WHOOP Coach generates responses on everything from training plans to why you’re feeling tired.
Menstrual Cycle Insights: Go beyond period tracking to better understand your fifth vital sign and get tailored cycle-based insights.
What else you can do in the WHOOP app:
• Dig into the details: See heart rate zones, VO₂ Max, steps, and more trends over time to adjust your behaviors, training, sleep and more based on your goals.
• Join a team: Stay motivated and accountable by joining a team. Chat directly with your teammates in the app, or as a coach, see how your team's training is going.
• Apple Health: WHOOP integrates with Apple's Health app to sync activities and personalize your experience.
WHOOP provides products and services designed for general fitness and wellness purposes. WHOOP products and services are not medical devices, not intended to treat or diagnose any disease, and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. All content available through WHOOP products and services is for general informational purposes only.
Discover the future of health and performance.
*Some availability restrictions apply.

bluejetty:00027466:ios.description:
Storyteller is the AI text to speech app that turns any text into lifelike, natural-sounding audio – at a fraction of the price of other voice apps.
Paste, type or scan text and hear it read aloud instantly by 500+ realistic AI voices in 45+ languages. Create voiceovers, audiobooks, narration and multi-voice stories, then download them as MP3.
WHY STORYTELLER
 • Premium voices for less – studio-quality AI voices without the studio price.
 • 500+ natural voices – male and female voices with adjustable style, pitch and speed.
 • 45+ languages and accents – English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic and many more.
 • Read aloud anything – articles, notes, emails, essays, scripts, books and homework.
 • Scan text – snap a photo of a page, worksheet or document and listen to it right away.
 • Multi-voice stories – give every character their own voice for dialogue, audio dramas and bedtime stories.
 • AI writer – need a script or a story? Storyteller GPT writes it for you, then reads it aloud.
 • MP3 export – save and share audio for videos, podcasts, presentations, e-learning and games.
 • Fine control – adjust speed, pitch, volume and speaking style, or use SSML.
PERFECT FOR
 • Content creators who need fast voiceovers for short videos, reels and podcasts
 • Students and readers who prefer to listen – great for accessibility, dyslexia and language learning
 • Teachers and parents reading stories aloud
 • Game developers, filmmakers and businesses who need voice acting and narration on a budget
HOW IT WORKS
 1. Paste, type or scan your text.
 2. Pick a voice and a speaking style.
 3. Tap play – then download your MP3 or share it.
SAVE TIME AND MONEY
 Skip expensive voice actors and pricey subscriptions. Storyteller gives you professional AI narration for less than the price of a cup of coffee.
PREMIUM
 Subscribe to unlock premium voices, higher character limits and an ad-free experience. Need more? Buy extra page bundles any time.

bluejetty:00028761:ios.description:
“I, as a Cat Hero, will vanquish all monsters tormenting my master in his dream!"
Fish Cannon? Check.
Cuteness and Bravery? Double Check!
It is a Cat Hero's sworn duty to protect their master from all forms of threat even if it means from their dreams.
However, even the dark of the nightmare can make a hero's fur stand up. But fear not for you are not alone! You will meet friends, companions, and join forces with other Cat Heroes from all over the world on this quest to make sure the master feeds the cat and cleans the hairballs sitting by the corners.
■ Explore the Vast Dreamland in Cute, Quality Graphics
Take on epic raid bosses, stroll along coastlines, fight the monsters of the ocean, and soar into the skies as you journey in this dreamland that is beautifully crafted in cute, quality graphics.
■ Simply Tap to Merge Fishes Endlessly and Grow Stronger
Merge fishes to make your fish missiles stronger. The Magic Tank will fill the fish so don't worry about running out of fish!
■ Meet Companions to Customize your Build for Greater Firepower
Choose from over 40 skills and 50 companions! Befriend Sausage, Bread, Chicken, Wolves, Pirates, and even a Tank Commander to unleash tons of damage. And let’s not forget about the runes that aid your build!
■ Join Forces with other Cat Heroes to Enjoy More Content
Cooperate with your guild to conquer the battlefield and win the siege. Win special gear and more rewards from the guild fights and share the sweet taste of victories with your mates.
■ Wind Down with Diverse Range of Contents for Endless Fun
Even Heroes need to catch a break every now and then. Customize in style with various skins and participate in various engaging minigames to get loads of rewards. Manage your Cat Town or visit someone else’s to either help or interrupt them! And when you are ready to battle again, test your strength in Arena for special rewards!
■ Let it Idle
Go offline and your companions will fight for you. AFK rewards pile up up to 24 hours, so come back any time to upgrade your team!
Join the ranks of Cat Heroes and protect your master’s dreams! Download and play now for free!

bluejetty:00022774:ios.description:
Searching for an exciting offline card game? Download Tonk, or Tunk - a “draw and discard” card game with 2 or 3 players. Played with 5 cards - It is a variation of Gin Rummy and knock rummy that is easy to learn, fun to play and free to download!
This single player version of Tonk is entirely free, can be played offline, without any wifi or cellphone and is guaranteed to give your hours of nonstop fun.
5 Reasons to WHY Tonk is #1
1. Play anytime - even when you are offline
2. 500+ Levels and Unlock high roller tables of 50,000 coins
3. Play at your own speed – Fast or slow
4. Get free coins every few hours
5. Simple & intuitive card game play interface
• VVIP Customer service – 
Have a problem or a suggestion in the card game? Email the Tonk development team directly and have your queries quickly resolved! We love hearing from players, and you can be sure to get answer from us at any time of the day
• Tonk Fan Club
Get your free invite to the exclusive Tonk Fan Club, where you can meet hundred’s of Tonk players
• Leaderboard
Play everyday and see how you match up with other players
Diamond club membership requires purchase of a Subscription, details of which are below:
• Weekly Auto-renewable subscription
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew weekly unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage (or Restore) your subscription including cancelling it from the Settings Menu
Subscription Terms of Service:
https://www.gariagames.com/subscription-terms
Subscription Privacy Policy:
https://gariagames.com/privacy-policy
We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it for you! See you at the Tunk table!
Important Disclaimer:
- This game is free to play and intended for entertainment purposes only. 
- Virtual coins and items have no real-world value and cannot be exchanged for money. 
- By playing, you agree to our Terms of Service (https://www.gariagames.com/terms-of-service) and Privacy Policy (https://gariagames.com/privacy-policy)

bluejetty:00030711:ios.name: Truck Maps Navigation
bluejetty:00030711:ios.summary: Truck Maps is a navigation app designed for professional truckers, bus drivers and RV enthusiasts. Tailored to the unique needs of larger vehicles, it goes beyond traditional navigation with specialized features for a safe and stress-free j
bluejetty:00030711:ios.description:
Truck Maps is a navigation app designed for professional truckers, bus drivers and RV enthusiasts. Tailored to the unique needs of larger vehicles, it goes beyond traditional navigation with specialized features for a safe and stress-free journey.
KEY FEATURES:
- Truck-, Bus-, and RV-Specific Routing
Truck Maps calculates routes optimized for the size and weight of your vehicle, taking into account low bridges, weight restrictions, and other road limitations.
- Customized Vehicle Profiles
Create vehicle profiles with height, weight, length, and other dimensions for accurate route planning. Profiles sync across all your devices.
- Voice-Guided Turn-by-Turn Navigation
Voice guidance announces upcoming maneuvers at the right moment — adapting to your speed. When a second turn follows closely, it tells you about that too. Works seamlessly with Bluetooth and CarPlay.
- Route Customization & Avoidance Options
Specify avoidance options such as toll roads, highways, or certain terrain types to create a personalized route.
- Real-Time Traffic Updates
Truck Maps dynamically adjusts your route to avoid congestion, helping you save time and fuel.
- Detailed Route Information
Distance, estimated travel time, turns, waypoints, weather, and color-coded traffic visualization — all at a glance.
- Road Shields
Familiar road shield icons displayed during navigation, just like real road signs.
ON THE ROAD:
- Live Activities on Lock Screen & Dynamic Island
See your next maneuver, remaining distance, and ETA right on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — even when your phone is locked.
- 3D Driving Indicator
A beautifully rendered 3D puck shows your exact position and heading on the map.
- Default Navigation App
Set Truck Maps as your default. When other apps open directions, Truck Maps takes over with truck-safe routing.
- Dashcam
Your device's camera doubles as a smart recorder, capturing your drive for added security.
PRODUCTIVITY:
- Frequent Addresses
Your most-used destinations appear as quick-select pills in the search bar for instant access.
- Usage Statistics & Trip Tracking
Track total trips, distance driven, average trip length, and driving time. View destinations on an interactive heatmap and browse charts over customizable time frames.
Download Truck Maps today and experience the road like never before!
Privacy Policy: https://bastian.codes/privacy-policy/truck-maps
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00017196:ios.summary:

Released in 2017 with over 110,000 downloads — a math-meets-art tool refined over 9 years.
Spirograph Maker turns the timeless mechanical drawing toy into a digital playground for your iP
bluejetty:00017196:ios.description:
Create mesmerizing geometric art with a single tap.
Released in 2017 with over 110,000 downloads — a math-meets-art tool refined over 9 years.
Spirograph Maker turns the timeless mechanical drawing toy into a digital playground for your iPhone and iPad. Choose your gears, pick your colors, and watch hypnotic patterns bloom across the screen — no drawing skill required.
WHERE MATH MEETS ART
The patterns Spirograph creates aren't accidents — they're governed by GCD/LCM and parametric equations. Watch how the lobe count is determined by n/gcd(n,m), see hypotrochoids and epitrochoids come alive on your screen. A visual companion for middle-school number theory and high-school parametric curves. Whether you're a curious learner, a math enthusiast, or just love beautiful patterns, this is where math becomes mesmerizing.
In 2022, this app was acknowledged in an academic paper on algebraic combinatorics — the smoothness criteria for Positroid varieties (Billey & Weaver, arXiv:2207.06508). From a child's toy to cutting-edge mathematical research — that's how deep these patterns go.
FOUR GEAR SHAPES
Not just circles. Draw with ellipse, rounded triangle (a curve of constant width), and teardrop gears too. Change the gear's shape and the symmetry of the pattern changes with it: circles stay regular, ellipses stretch, triangles beat in threes, teardrops curve organically. A strength slider tunes each shape continuously — from nearly circular to a flat ellipse, or a sharply pointed triangle or teardrop.
KEY FEATURES
- Draw by hand: drag your finger around the gears to roll them and draw the pattern yourself
- Auto-draw mode: tap once and beautiful patterns appear on their own
- Custom color palette with gradient mode for endless combinations
- Adjustable gear shapes and sizes: circle / ellipse / rounded triangle / teardrop, plus tooth count
- Live preview of gear settings
- Undo / Redo (optionally including gear settings)
- Save your creations directly to your Photo Library
- Share to Instagram, Facebook, or anywhere
- Full iPad support — a bigger canvas for finer detail
- Light and Dark mode
WHY SPIROGRAPH MAKER
- A meditative break from a busy day — without leaving your phone
- A visual bridge between middle-school math and university geometry
- Inspired by the classic Spirograph toy, reimagined for modern iOS
- Perfect for parents, students, artists, and math enthusiasts
- Works offline, anywhere
PERFECT FOR
- Winding down before bed
- Sparking creativity with kids
- A short math meditation anytime
- Making one-of-a-kind wallpapers
- Sharing unique art on Instagram
- A short, calm focus break during your day
In Japan, downloads notably spike around the start of new school terms and summer breaks — pointing to a growing use as a learning companion.
Pull out your phone, tap once, and watch sacred geometry unfold. Whether you're a designer, a doodler, a student, or just love beautiful patterns, Spirograph Maker is the simplest way to make art that mesmerizes.
Free to download. Optional ad-free upgrade available.

bluejetty:00013726:ios.description:
The Bible is the book of the Church. Read like you believe it.
Most Bible apps give you the verse. Verbum helps you understand it with over forty free Bibles (including the USCCB’s approved translations) and books, including powerful commentaries, homily prep tools, and writings from renowned theologians and Church Fathers. Create a free account and start exploring:
* Reading Plans: Build a habit with plans you can customize and share.
* Study Assistant: Ask a question, get answers drawn only from your Logos books (limited free uses).
* Smart Search: Search your Bible by verse, topic, or the question you actually have (limited free uses).
* Factbook: Uncover instant background on the people, places, and ideas you run into.
* Notes: Take notes that travel with you everywhere.
Every tool is free to try. If you want to keep going, a subscription gets you more use of AI features like Study Assistant and Smart Search, access to more books, and even subscriber-exclusive free books and discounts. 
This app offers optional subscription plans called Verbum Plus and Premium. If you choose to subscribe,
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least twenty-four hours before the end of the current period. 
* Your account will be charged for renewal within twenty-four hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of renewal.
* You can manage your subscriptions or turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00031681:ios.description:
With Swish Live, broadcast your sports events, like on TV, from your smartphone!
Manage yourself the scoreboard in real time. The app will embed in your live: names of teams, colors of jerseys, remaining time and scoreboard depending on the sport you practice.
You can now stream all your matches directly to your Facebook, Youtube page or anywhere !

• Inlay of an editable scorecard in real time:
• The title of the match (Championship Day, Cup Final, ...)

• The color of the jerseys of each team

• For basketball, bring up the quarter-time your team is playing
• Inlay of your sponsor's logo

Swish Live is a very easy application to set up. Set up your match easily in a matter of minutes and go live on your club page very quickly.

bluejetty:00039713:ios.description:
Learn to feel better and get to know yourself using Cogni!
Cogni is the easiest, quickest and fun way for you to write down your thought records. These records are widely used in Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), but they can be useful even for non-therapists.
BENEFITS:
  • Easy to learn and use
  • Your notes are always with you!
  • Practical and easy to record your emotions
  • Record emotions with few touches on the screen
  • You don't even need to write if you don't want to
  • Take notes wherever you are
  • All your records in one place
  • Get more out of your therapy sessions
  • Never again forget to report something to your therapist
For those who do not yet know, Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (or simply CBT) is a type of psychotherapy, as well as psychoanalysis and other types of therapy. CBT has been growing a lot around the world, due to the practical treatment approach and the excellent results it has achieved.

bluejetty:00035472:ios.name: Sporfie
bluejetty:00035472:ios.summary:
Using just a smartphone, a GoPro or Mevo camera you can live stream your games, practices and more, allowing family and friends to join and watch live at NO cost to the viewer. 
Plus, add multiple smartphone cameras and everyone at the gam
bluejetty:00035472:ios.description:
Using just a smartphone, a GoPro or Mevo camera you can live stream your games, practices and more, allowing family and friends to join and watch live at NO cost to the viewer. 
Plus, add multiple smartphone cameras and everyone at the game can save highlights just after they happen, replay them seconds later and share them instantly. 
• No Cost for Viewers and No Login Required: Friends and family can watch your games live for no fee. In fact, they don’t even need to create an account! Share a link to your team’s landing page, so anyone can quickly watch your games or practice sessions.
• Private Events: Add a pin code to your events to keep your games or practices restricted to the audience you want, whether that’s just parents, coaches or players.
• Add the Score in Real-Time: With our crowd-sourced scoreboard feature, parents can update the score throughout the game. The scoreboard is shown on the live feed, on the individual clips and on the game replay.
• Instant Highlights During the Game and After: With just the press of a button, Sporfie saves your highlights AFTER you’ve seen it happen, whether you’re at the game from the sidelines, watching the live stream remotely, or watching the full-game replay. 
• Start Streaming with Just Your Mobile Device: With just one smartphone camera filming the action, anyone who joins can enjoy the game without having to film and still save their own personal highlights instantly.
• Replay the Full-Game from the Cloud: The entire game’s footage is saved in the Cloud, so you can replay, save highlights and download the action anytime.
Also available: 
Want to capture hands-free? Using the Sporfie CLIPR button, you can now leave your smartphone in your pocket or bag and wirelessly capture the action in one click!

bluejetty:00035277:ios.description:
ĐẤU THẦN TUYỆT THẾ - Xứng tầm Tân Vương game nhập vai xuất thế
 Tuyệt phẩm game mobile MMORPG tiên hiệp mới nhất trên thị trường đã có mặt tại Việt Nam.
 Đồ họa 3D siêu việt, hiệu ứng mãn nhãn, gameplay đa dạng và hấp dẫn, cốt truyện lôi cuốn, xứng đáng là game MMORPG 3D hàng đầu hiện nay.
 Dựa trên tuyệt tác ngôn tình tiên hiệp “Từng Thề Ước - Thượng Cổ Tình Ca”, tựa game Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế mở ra một thế giới thần thoại đầy huyền ảo, nơi thần - ma - yêu - nhân không ngừng tu luyện và tranh đấu để giành lấy lãnh địa, xưng bá khắp cõi hồng hoang. Đây là thời kỳ đầy hỗn loạn nhưng cũng không kém phần lãng mạn bởi cảnh sắc như tiên như mộng, bạt ngàn linh thú, kỳ hoa dị thảo cùng những mối tình thiên cổ rung động đất trời.
 Đến với Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế, bạn sẽ được đắm chìm vào một cuộc phiêu lưu mới trên con đường tu tiên, gặp gỡ kết giao với nhiều tiên hữu khác để cùng chiến đấu trong những màn PK nảy lửa, và biết đâu tìm được một nửa đích thực của mình.
 [Tuyệt bản tiên hiệp - Tinh hoa tiên hiệp hội tụ]
 - 7 class nhân vật cùng hệ thống ngoại quan đồ sộ lên đến hàng trăm loại tiên dực, tiên kỵ, tiên sủng, thần binh,...giúp bạn thoải mái sáng tạo nhân vật. 
 - Độc Tôn Lĩnh Vực: tự kiến tạo nên Lĩnh Vực của bạn, không ai có thể xâm phạm.
 - Triệu hồi Thượng Cổ Dị Thú: sở hữu những linh thú có 1 không 2 trong lịch sử.
 - Tiên Linh: Hóa thân vào các nhân vật huyền thoại như Nữ Oa, Tôn Ngộ Không,...
 [Tuyệt sắc đồ họa - Mãn nhãn mọi góc nhìn]
 - Hồng Mông Thần Tàng, Quy Khư Mộng Diễn: Hàng chục set đồ thời trang cực kỳ hoành tráng chỉ có được khi dày công sưu tập, đặc biệt có thể kết hợp tạo nên 7749 phong cách.
 - Đồ họa 3D siêu việt, zoom cận cảnh chất lượng cao, hiệu ứng skill ngoạn mục giúp bạn trải nghiệm sắc nét vẻ đẹp hoàn mỹ trong từng khung hình.
 [Tuyệt đỉnh PK - PK đỉnh thống lĩnh tam giới]
 - Hệ thống PVE - PVP chiến trường tranh bá đa dạng và hoành tráng, cung cấp nội dung khiêu chiến liên tục, đặc biệt là Tranh Bá Tinh Đồ liên 2-8 server tranh đoạt cứ điểm vô cùng kịch tính.
 - Hệ thống kết nghĩa 5 huynh đệ đồng sinh cộng tử cùng nhau tu tiên, làm nhiệm vụ, săn boss,...cực kỳ khác biệt và mới lạ.
[Tuyệt tác tình duyên - Đắm chìm vào thế giới tình duyên đầy cảm xúc]
 - Tính năng tình duyên vô cùng phong phú bao gồm bồi dưỡng tình cảm, phụ bản tình duyên, tặng hoa, khóa đồng tâm, bảo bảo…giúp cho bạn và nửa kia ngày càng thắt chặt tình cảm - ”Đấu Thần Tuyệt Thế - Không lo bị ế”
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 1091/QĐ-BTTTT ngày 22/06/2023
Link giấy phép: https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/131169

bluejetty:00039899:ios.description:
Log into your Strava account and visualise your outdoor run and cycling activity routes on a 3D map for free! Rerun lets you playback your outdoor runs and cycling activities in real time. Training stats are also shown on a graph in realtime.
Training for a Marathon? Taking your bike out for a Ride? Rerun turns your iOS device into a sophisticated running cycling outdoor visualizer.
Note: this application will require access to your Strava account. Visualised workouts must be outdoor Strava activities which have GPS coordinates. Supported outdoor activities include Run, Rides, Hikes, Walks Skiing and Snowboarding.
If you like this app, Rerun is also available on the Mac App Store!

bluejetty:00014313:ios.description:
Know what you have, where it is, and your take home profits at a glance. Inventory Now tracks every item from purchase to sale — barcode scanning, real-time team sync, Square checkout, and true profit after expenses. Built for resellers, small shops, and any team managing stock across locations.
SCAN ANYTHING — Use your camera or an external scanner to find or add items instantly. Generate your Barcodes and SKUs. WIth Smart Scan: snap a photo and we'll create the item for you, with a suggested retail price.
SELL AND GET PAID — Create orders and take payments. Accept in-person payments through Square Point of Sale or Tap to Pay on iPhone. Track order status, customer details, refunds and returns. Send professional invoices and receipts in seconds.
KNOW YOUR REAL PROFIT — Track unit cost and auto-calculate sale prices and margins. Log expenses so your profit numbers are real. See inventory value, sales, and profit at a glance.
WORK AS A TEAM — Sync across devices and team members, so everyone sees the same stock. Run stocktake sessions together: scan what's on the shelf, reconcile against what the system says, and review the report as the numbers come together.
CONNECT YOUR CHANNELS — Sync with Shopify. Push listings to eBay or Etsy with one click and track the orders that come back. Send expenses and revenue to QuickBooks.
NEVER RUN OUT — Get notified when stock dips low. Inventory Now estimates days of stock remaining and lets you set your own reorder thresholds by quantity or lead time.
ORGANIZE IT YOUR WAY — Name, category, subcategory, UPC, SKU, location, images, notes, and custom fields. Add variants and track quantities across multiple locations. Sort, filter, and search to find anything instantly. Move data in and out with CSV import and export. Use Average cost basis for first-in-first-out cost calculations.
EVERYWHERE YOU WORK — Use it on iPhone, iPad, MacOS and any device with a web browser. Your data is backed up automatically and can be restored at any time.
SUBSCRIPTIONS — Inventory Now is free to try. Full functionality requires a service subscription:
Personal — core inventory tracking for a single user, from $10 / mo.
Professional — for teams and advanced features, from $20 / mo.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.inventorynow.com/terms-of-service 
Privacy Policy: https://www.inventorynow.com/privacy-policy
Questions? support@inventorynow.com

bluejetty:00016006:ios.description:
The Australian Open just hits different.
Every January, Melbourne Park comes alive with big serves, bigger moments, and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else.
The official Australian Open 2026 app brings it all together, with something for everyone.
New for 2026
• Sign in to personalise your AO experience
• Get closer to the stars with improved player profiles full of social content and deeper insights

Your AO, your way

bluejetty:00027039:ios.name: Metar-Taf
bluejetty:00027039:ios.summary:
Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. 
METAR features: 
- Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics
- Weather
bluejetty:00027039:ios.description:
Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. 
METAR features: 
- Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics
- Weather symbols for significant weather and clouds, like in a non-aviation weather report
- Crosswind calculations, by combining METAR and runway information
- Flight rules category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR
- Read out by text-to-speech available, listen to a decoded METAR while doing other things
TAF features:
- TAF broken down and displayed per hour in a table
- Show sunrise/sunset, minimum and maximum temperature
Keeping track:
- Add your favorite stations to the list, see their weather at a glance
- Get observations near your location
- Find stations in the interactive map with weather codes
- Search airports by ICAO code or name
History:
- Graphs with weather trends today and yesterday: temperature, visibility, wind speed, QNH
- METAR history for the last hours and link to more on the website
Airport information:
- See information about the airports, like runway directions, elevation, location 
- If the airport doesn't report a METAR, the nearest station used for calculations
Calculations:
- All units are customizable units: speed (knots, km/h, m/s, mph), altitude (meters/feet), visibility (kilometers/miles), temperature (Celcius/Fahrenheit) and air pressure (Hectopascal, Inch Hg)
- Times are converted to the local time for each airport
- Sunrise and sunset are calculated based on the airports latitude/longitude
General:
- METAR, TAF and airport data are automatically saved for offline use
- Available in 6 languages: English, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

bluejetty:00024655:ios.description:
Our application is the first sports application in Kurdistan Region and Iraq. The application is designed to get details and results of all Kurdistan and Iraqi competitions in both Kurdish and Arabic languages. We aim to provide up to date results to sports fans in parallel with giants leagues across the globe.
Stay up to date with all the latest scores, results and statistics on your mobile. This application provides results and statistics of more than 100 clubs and 2000 players across Kurdistan Region and Iraq. Like modern applications the SHOT provides up to date league ranking, goal scorers, match results of all Kurdistan and Iraqi leagues.
ئهپلیكهیشنهكهمان یهكهم ئهپلیكهیشنی وهرزشییه لهسهر ئاستی كوردستان و عێراق، تیایدا به زمانی كوردی و عهرهبی ئهنجام و وردهكاریی سهرجهم یارییهكانی خولهكانی تۆپی پێی كوردستان و عێراق وهشان دهكرێن، ئامانجمانه هاوشێوهی خوله بههێزهكانی جیهان ههوادارانی تۆپی پێ لهسهر ئاستی كوردستان و عێراق سات به سات له رێگای مۆبایلهكانیان ئاگاداری ئهنجام و رووداوهكانی یارییهكانی خوله ناوخۆییهكان بن.
ئامار و ئهنجامی یارییهكانی زیاتر له 100 یانه و 2000 یاریزان لهسهر ئاستی كوردستان و عێراق له ئهپلیكهیشنهكهمان بهردهستن، هاوشێوهی ئهپلیكهیشنه ههره پێشكهوتووهكانی جیهان سات به سات ئامار و ریزبهندی و ئهنجامی یارییهكانی خولی نایابی كوردستان و عێراق و خولهكانی دیكه له ئهپلیكهیشنهكهمان نوێ دهكرێنهوه.
معلومات حول تطبيق شوت تطبيق شوت هو التطبيق الرياضي الأول في إقليم كوردستان والعراق. تم تصميم التطبيق للحصول على تفاصيل ونتائج جميع مسابقات في إقليم كوردستان والعراق باللغتين الكوردية والعربية. يهدف تطبيق شوت إلى تقديم نتائج محدثة للبطولات العالمية لعشاق الرياضة. كُن على اطلاع دائم بأحدث النتائج والإحصائيات على هاتفك المحمول. يوفر هذا التطبيق نتائج وإحصائيات لأكثر من 100 نادي و 2000 لاعب في إقليم كوردستان والعراق. كالتطبيقات العالمية، يوفر تطبيق SHOT ترتيب الدوريات، الهدافين و نتائج المباريات لجميع الدوريات الكوردستانية والعراقية.

bluejetty:00035752:ios.name: Fal Cafe
bluejetty:00035752:ios.summary:
Fal baktırmak için birilerini aramanıza gerek kalmadı. Kahve falı baktırmak için, en büyük sanal eğlenceniz, Fal Cafe her an yanınızda. 
Kahvenizi keyifle için ve fincanınızı çevirip biraz bekleyin. Sonra fotoğraflarını çekip bize gönderin
bluejetty:00035752:ios.description:
Fal baktırmak için birilerini aramanıza gerek kalmadı. Kahve falı baktırmak için, en büyük sanal eğlenceniz, Fal Cafe her an yanınızda. 
Kahvenizi keyifle için ve fincanınızı çevirip biraz bekleyin. Sonra fotoğraflarını çekip bize gönderin. Sizler için yorumlayalım.
Birbirinden değerli falcılarımız, her fincanı dikkatle inceliyor, size özel yorumları uzun uzun yapıyor. 
Ayrıca dilerseniz fallarınızı sesli olarak yorumluyoruz.
Bu nedenle falların cevaplanma süresi 10 dakika ile yarım saat arası bir zamanı bulabiliyor. Yoğun ilginiz ve sabrınız için teşekkür ederiz.
Niyet Falı ile beklemeden falını okuyabilirsin. Niyetini seç ve falını hemen oku!
Özellikler:
* Sesli Fal ile fallarını sesli olarak baktırabilirsiniz.
* Yorum için fotoğrafları hem albümden hem de kameradan doğrudan gönderebilirsiniz.
* Yorumlanmış fallarınız gelen kutusunda saklanır.
* Yorum bekleyen fallarınızı takip edebilirsiniz.
* Her saat başı bedava krediler dağıtılır
* Günlük ücretsiz fal baktırabilirsiniz.
* Karakter özelliklerinizi bir kez tanımlamanız yeterlidir.
* Günün her saatinde fal baktırabilirsiniz.
* Yorumcularımızın size gönderdiği yorumları beğenebilirsiniz.
* Niyet Falı ile beklemeden falını oku.
Kullanım Şartları: https://falcafe.mstapps.com/tos.html

"Highly customizable and polished" -The Best Apps for Reading Comics on Your iP
bluejetty:00060702:ios.description:
iComics® is a Universal app designed for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch that allows you to read DRM-free comics from your own collection, quickly and smoothly! 
"Highly customizable and polished" -The Best Apps for Reading Comics on Your iPad, MakeUseOf, 2015
"Attractively designed" -Best Comic File Readers, AppAdvice, 2015
Supporting all of the major comic formats, iComics makes it extremely easy to import comic files onto your iOS device and start reading them straight away! 
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
Features 
* Supports all of the major comic formats (ZIP, CBZ, RAR, CBR, 7ZIP, CB7, TAR, CBT, LZH, LHA, EPUB, PDF). 
* Collections for organizing sets of comics.
* Hot jumping directly from one comic to the next.
* Super smooth scrolling when turning pages.

Access EZ-Link’s functionalities and services all at your fingertips!

Enhanced EZ-Link Wallet with Mastercard® acceptance Safe, secure and seamless payments are now possible with the EZ-Link Wallet, now with Mastercard acceptance! Add your virtual Mastercard for online shopping and payments for services such as subscriptions payment, now available with the Pay by Wallet feature!
Top up your EZ-Link The top up function has arrived on iOS. Conveniently top up your EZ-Link cards, charms or wearables anytime and anywhere!

bluejetty:00044940:ios.description:
If you’re a JEA MyWay customer and want to manage your prepaid utilities account,
search for “JEA MyWay” in your app store to download that app.
My JEA makes it easier to do business with JEA and so much more. Whether you need
to view and pay your bill, check your utility consumption, report electric and water
outages, update your account information, or get help from our Customer Solutions
team, My JEA helps you get it done so you can get on with your day.
Easy Login: Sign in with the same credentials you use for your jea.com account. Don’t
have an account? It’s easy to set one up, right on the app.
View and Pay Your Bill: View your actual PDF bill and download if you need it. Pay your
way with a bank account, debit/credit card, or mobile wallet.
Check Your Consumption: View a graph of your electric and water usage with a
temperature overlay. View full screen in landscape mode for even more detail.
Sign Up for eBill Paperless Billing: You’re already going paperless with My JEA. Take
the next step by signing up for eBill, right from your account profile.
Request Payment Assistance: Need a little extra time to make a payment? Request a
payment extension or payment arrangement and get an instant answer.
Report Outages: View our Electric Outage Map in full screen mode. Report electric and
water outages and get updates on restoration progress.
Get Assistance: A single click will connect you by phone to JEA support. You can also
get directions to our Customer Solutions Center and make an appointment online for
faster service when you arrive.
Update Your Contact Info: Need to update your billing address, email or phone
number? Easily update your account profile inside the app.
Future Enhancements: Be on the lookout for new features with your convenience in
mind.

bluejetty:00041734:ios.description:
Welcome to BestLevel! This is the essential app for clients working with trainers or sport clubs using the BestLevel platform. Access your personalized training plans, track your progress, and stay connected with your coach, all in one place.
Your fitness journey is personal, and BestLevel is here to support every step.
Key Features for Clients:
- **Access Your Training Plans:** View the workout programs assigned by your trainer, complete with exercises, detailed instructions, sets, reps, rest times, and more.
- **Exercise Library:** Find detailed information and potentially video demonstrations for each exercise in your plan (mention videos if your app supports them).
- **Log Your Workouts:** Easily record completed sets, reps, weights, and notes after each session to keep a detailed history of your performance.
- **Track Your Progress:** Monitor your improvements over time with personal metrics, progress photos, and performance charts (if applicable). See how far you've come!
- **Communicate with Your Trainer:** Send messages directly to your coach for questions, feedback, or support (if applicable, mention this).
- **View Events & Schedules:** Stay informed about upcoming training sessions, classes, or events scheduled by your club or trainer.
- **Stay Motivated:** Have your entire plan and progress history at your fingertips to keep you on track and motivated.
BestLevel makes it easy to follow your plan, stay accountable, and achieve your fitness goals with the guidance of your trainer.
Download BestLevel and take control of your fitness!

bluejetty:00042424:ios.description:
Find immediate customized peer support by connecting anonymously with someone who understands your pain. WhiteFlag is a peer support app that connects people who are struggling with mental health and addiction issues with others who have been there too. 
WhiteFlag is changing the way people in pain communicate and heal. It’s free for users, and it always will be – no judgment, just real people helping people heal.
Finding support doesn't have to be hard. WhiteFlag offers a safe space where you will find acceptance, connection, and understanding among peers.
You’re not alone! And you never have to feel that way again.
Start healing today by selecting exactly what you are going through (depression, substance use disorder, loneliness, or suicide of loved one, for example.) Once you’ve chosen the filters that coincide with your life, simply Raise your WhiteFlag and receive immediate support from those who have personal experience with your struggles.
Also, are you the type of person who wants to help others but don’t know who needs it and where to find them? WhiteFlag is for you. Give support to those who are struggling with mental health and addiction issues in real-time, when they need it the most. 
The WhiteFlag movement is dedicated to:
Acceptance – No judgment, just real people helping people in pain.
Connection – You are not alone. We help you connect with people who understand your pain.
Support – Get help and give help. Immediately. Anonymously. Free.
Healing – Don't give up. WhiteFlag is a safe space where it's okay to not be okay.
Download the WhiteFlag App today!

bluejetty:00036694:ios.description:
Are you ready for an adventure that will take you on a wild ride through the dark side of Grand Gangster? 
Once the right hand of the gang, you abandoned your family for the love of a woman they disapproved of, becoming a prodigal son in the process. However, good times are fleeting... Your former girlfriend has now moved on to a new love, a mere punk from your old clan. Faced with this harsh reality, you decide to return and reclaim your place in the family business.
Yet, Vice Nation has changed dramatically in your absence, and everything you once knew is now different. With only your loyal friend Beverly by your side, you must navigate this lawless city to rejuvenate the family’s fortunes. Unbeknownst to you, a storm of intrigue is brewing, adding complexity to your already challenging journey...
【Game Features】
Manage Night Club, Take Control
Take charge of your night club! Here, every decision you make impacts your club's reputation and bottom line. From hiring staff, booking talent, to orchestrating unforgettable parties, it's up to you to create the ultimate nightlife hotspot. You can acquire wealth, charm, luxury cars, exquisite wines, and the ultimate power that's just within your reach!
Sandbox Strategy, Perfect Takeover
As you level up, you'll be able to unlock more minions to help you expand your territory. Unlock all kinds of Enforcers for your gang! From Amy's fierce whip to Phoenix's Gatling gun, no other gang will dare stand in your way.
Expand Your Territory, Explore New Areas
Upgrade your buildings, research new technology, train your henchmen, loot resources, march freely on the map, and expand your territory! The world is at your fingertips!
Exhilarating Battles, Epic Teamwork
Whether you prefer fighting at the front lines or supporting others back in the HQ, you'll experience the thrill of fighting side by side with your allies and let yourself shine!
Loving Grand Gangster War? Visit our social media at the link below to discover more about the game!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564459084149
Discord: https://discord.gg/BvHsvE4Tz5
Subscription Rules:
1. Subscription Validity: 30 days (from the day of purchase until the 30th day at 11:59:59 p.m.).
2. Once subscribed, the following can be claimed daily: Purple Diamond*800, 60m Speedup*2, 60m Building Speedup*2, 60m Research Speedup*2, Lv.3 Resource Custom Chest*5.
3. During the subscription period, you can enjoy the following features: Research Speed +10%, Training Speed +5%, Stamina Recovery +5%, Building Speed +5%.
4. New subscription fees will be automatically deducted once the subscription validity ends. If you wish to unsubscribe, you will need to do it manually.
5. Your iTunes account will be charged after you confirm your subscription.
6. Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless canceled at least 24 hours before your current subscription ends.
7. Your account will receive the purchase and price confirmation within 24 hours prior to the end of your current subscription period.
8. After subscribing, you can end the subscription service you purchased in your Account Settings.

Watch IPTV from your Internet Service Provider or free live TV channels from any ot
bluejetty:00038036:ios.description:
GSE IPTV Player is a free advanced Media player for watching online IPTV / TV, EPG, VOD, Video Series and Movies, Catch-up TV directly on your iOS devices.
Watch IPTV from your Internet Service Provider or free live TV channels from any other source on the web, the application is only a player and does not contain any preset channels or streams. You need to add a playlists and EPGs of your IPTV/OTT provider.
Features:
- Supports m3u & Xtream Codes API
- Powerful search & sorting
- Built-in powerful 4K IPTV player 
- Support for network streams, including HTTP Live streaming (HLS) , MMS or RTSP & Smooth Streaming
- Simple, fast, powerful & user-friendly layout
- Multiple channel playlist supported
Disclaimer:
- GSE IPTV Player is a video player without any content.
- GSE IPTV Player does not offer any kind of content or media, users must provide their own content.
- GSE IPTV Player has no affiliation with any third-party provider what so ever.
- We simply handle the user information in an intuitive way as long as the user have the access.
- We do not endorse the streaming of copyright-protected material without permission from the copyright holder.
To unlock all content, the following auto-renewing subscription options are available:
• 1 month: US$ 4.99 / month;
• 3 months: US$ 9.99 / 3 months;
• 12 months: US$ 14.99 / year.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
Subscriptions can be managed and canceled after purchase by going to your account settings in the App Store.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PJzruBBzw2mYoq79Q3vQcnjrkJsRvnaOIXosk8xVxP0
Terms Of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kQpDWPTOU7dWt6-JxvXL-bDToYhKcAdms85uNdFLuJY

bluejetty:00015307:ios.name: The Human Body: Learn Anatomy
bluejetty:00015307:ios.summary:

With "How does the Human Body Work?" you
bluejetty:00015307:ios.description:
Explore the human body and discover how your organs and muscles work. Play and learn as you watch the heart pump blood, where the food we eat passes, why a mosquito bite hurts us and much, much more!
With "How does the Human Body Work?" you can play and learn freely, with no pressure or stress. Play, observe, ask questions and find the answers. Have fun controlling your character, feeding him and cutting his nails. 
Enter our machine and watch how the blood platelets plug the wounds, how the muscles contract to kick a balloon or how a baby grows inside its mother. 
Learn and concentrate on healthy habits, watch how the lungs get sick if we breathe a lot of smoke, how running and exercise is good for your health and how the human body is healthier and stronger if you eat a balanced diet. We only have one body, let's take care of it!
With 9 incredible interactive scenes:
Circulatory system
Zoom into the heart and see how it pumps blood. Discover white blood cells, platelets and red blood cells, and see how they work to make your body healthy. 
Respiratory System
Watch your character inhale as see how the air goes to the lungs, bronchi and alveoli. Play by controlling your character and seeing how the rhythm of his breathing changes.
Urogenital system
Learn what the kidneys and bladder do. Interact with your character and help clean the blood and make him pee. 
Digestive system
What path does the food follow from its entry into the human body until the waste comes out? Feed the character and help him absorb the nutrients and dispose of the waste. 
Nervous System
Observe how the nerves of the whole body are activated and how the senses work: sight, smell, hearing... and also learn about the brain and its various parts. 
Skeletal System
In this system, you'll learn how the skeleton is made up of many bones, how they give us mobility and allow us to walk, jump, run... and how your bones are responsible for generating the blood of our body. 
Muscular System
Learn how your body contracts and relaxes the muscles to help us move, protect us and learn the names of the most important muscles. You can turn your character around and see that we have other muscles on the other side!
The Skin 
Discover how the skin protects us and how it responds to cold and heat. Watch how the hairs grow, clean the sweat of your character and play by cutting its nails and painting them. 
Pregnancy
Take care of the pregnant woman, take her blood pressure, do an ultrasound and observe how a baby is forming inside her. 
Suitable for all ages, starting at 4 years old.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

Play your way — anytime, anywhere, online or offline!
Perfect for beginners and experts alike, Puzzle Crown lets you adjust the difficulty of your jigsaw puzzles from easy to hard with 11 levels and up to 660 pieces. You don't need Wi-Fi and you can enjoy it online or offline.
Have Some Fun!
Turn your favorite photos into custom jigsaw puzzles for free! Upload your images, make your own picture puzzles and share them with friends and family.
Challenge Your Brain!
Solve Mystery jigsaw puzzles and boost your concentration as you place pieces to uncover the final picture. Perfect for seniors!
Take a Break from Everyday Stress!
Instead of scrolling through Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok, sit back and relax with this anxiety relief puzzle game. With beautiful puzzles featuring nature, landmarks, animals, art, and fantasy, there’s always something new to play.
Download now and enjoy your FREE welcome jigsaw puzzles today!
Fun Guaranteed!
- Over 15,000 HD Jigsaw Puzzles in Landscape Mode: Enjoy a larger play area and more immersive jigsaw puzzles than any other game in the store. With thousands of stunning images to solve, boredom is never an option!
- DAILY New Puzzles: Stay away from dementia by playing jigsaws every day and keeping your brain active.
- WEEKLY New Collection with 20 Picture Puzzles: Endless fun awaits!
- SEASONAL Events: Celebrate Christmas, Easter, Valentine’s Day, Thanksgiving, and Halloween with playing themed jigsaw puzzles.

- Improved Concentration: Take a break from everyday life and center your mind on challenging jigsaw puzzles.

Why Wait?
- Landscape Mode: Enjoy the relaxing experience of solving a jigsaw puzzle in wide-screen on both mobile and tablet.
- Unique Puzzle Pieces: Explore Classic, Figural, and Spiral cuts for a daily new challenge.

- Helpful Hints: Stuck on a jigsaw puzzle? Use the ghost picture to guide your progress.
- Rotating Pieces: Activate rotation mode to add an extra layer of difficulty and test your cognitive skills.

- Coin Rewards: Earn coins by completing jigsaws and use them to unlock new games.

Join the community of jigsaw puzzle lovers!
Download Puzzle Crown today and enjoy thousands of jigsaw puzzles and daily new games. Your joy is our goal! Play everyday and keep your brain sharp, reduce your anxiety, and relax!
